مقدمة

This 
document outlines the equipment inspection steps, required for fuel oil 
filter (this filter is used for cleaning the fuel oil from any impurites).

This 
inspection performed depending on pressure difference across the filter as 
indicated in the above title block.

The 
first draft initiated by eng. عبد الله 
محمد عبد الله, reviewed by director eng. جمال
عرفة,
tested by eng. 
Ibrahem Sherqawy, accepted by general director eng. Mohamed. Abd El-سلام، ووافق عليها المهندس. 
Michael George Head sector of Ayoun Moussa steam power station 2 x 320 MW

هذه الوثيقة 
مقبولة من قبل
م. سمير عبد الجليل؛ منسق EDEPC MPIS، ومعتمد من قبل 
المحاسب محمود محمد سليمان؛ مدير عام الشؤون الإدارية والمالية 
مراقبة الجودة، والمشرف على رئيس التفتيش ومراقبة الجودة EDEPC 
القطاع.
احتياطات السلامة

A work permit 
must be issued, 
و tانه صيانة 
يجب أن يحمل الموظفون فئة السلامة المناسبة،

Safety fence 
with caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear the 
 safety and healthy equipment as
 أمان
 helmet, shoes, eye glass, nose mouth "dust cover" .... etc

يجب عزل المرشح ميكانيكياً عن طريق إغلاق:
 * Input and output 
 valves of Mazout.
 * Steam and condensate 
 valve.
 * Drain the filter by 
 opening the drain valve.
 * De-aerated filter by 
 opening de-aeration valves.

sections.text: الأدوات والمعدات
مجموعة أدوات الصيانة الكاملة
سائل التنظيف
العمل المراد تنفيذه

The filter element has to 
be cleaned or the cartridge changed at a differential pressure of 0.8 bar
Procedure for Dismantling and Cleaning the Filter

Open the air vent of the 
isolated filter, this relieves the liquid pressure.

قم بتفكيك غطاء الغلاف 
من المرشح المعزول.
Open the drain.

Drain the liquid down to 
the strainer base.

Remove the filter element 
vertically upwards.

Clean the filter element by 
cleaning fluid and by compressed air.

sections.text: Procedure for assembling the filter after Cleaning

Install the filter element 
after cleaning.

When mounting the cover, 
check that the seal is in perfect condition and seated properly; if necessary, 
replace seal. Screw cover on, the air vent remains open.
Close drain.

Slowly start up plant. 
Open the inlet shut-off valve slightly close air vent as soon as the air has 
escaped and liquid emerges.

افتح كلا صمامي الإغلاق 
بالكامل.

Slowly start up plant.

escaped and liquid emerges.
